decided: A change's account of what it built is written or rewritten only when the change's building work is complete, so the program brief always describes finished work; when a review reopens work, the account is rewritten once, when that work is finished again.
alternatives: rewrite the account in every building session whose work changes what it says, finished or not
why: The user chose it at the walk: one rule covers the first account and every rewrite, and the brief never shows half-done work.
